name: Julius AI
tagline: AI workspace for data analysis, research and creation
description: Julius is an AI workspace to analyse data and research, create presentations and reports, build websites and generate images and video, with credits by plan.
features: Analyse files and create charts and presentations
Reports and dashboards from your data
Data connectors on higher plans (Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres)
Websites, images and video with limited use on lower plans
useCases: Producing reports and presentations from data
strengths: A free plan with daily credits
Credits and connectors are listed per plan
limitations: The page did not make clear whether the monthly prices shown assume monthly or annual billing

free.details: Free: $0 per month with free daily credits, Julius Lite models and limited use of the presentation, image, video and website tools.

plans.name: Plus
plans.billing: $20 per month as shown; billing interval unclear

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: $45 per month as shown; billing interval unclear

plans.name: Business
plans.billing: $450 per month as shown; billing interval unclear

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. The page has an 'Annual Billing: save 20%' and a 'Monthly Billing' toggle, and we could not tell which view the figures belong to.
